text:
Priya (Partnerships): FYI - OrionCloud just pushed our rack shipment by ~2 weeks. ETA now 2025-05-24 (was 2025-05-10). This affects APAC Private + SI onboarding. Need triage on announcement and capacity swaps. :eyes:

Jorge (Logistics): Any chance of partial shipments? We can stagger if partner can split by rack.

Priya (Partnerships): Partner said they can split but firmware images for 3 racks are delayed until vendor QA next week. So partial still has risk.

Evelyn (Product): For the joint announcement timeline — we have marketing assets locked for May 16. If we delay announcement we risk missing press window. Can Sales accept a staggered customer-commit cadence?

Marta (Sales): Not ideal but workable. We can push the formal launch by one week if we give enterprise customers a clear timeline. Need confirmation on which customers are impacted.

Sam (Eng-Infra): Ops ask: can we route affected SI trials to eu-west spare capacity? We have 4 racks free May 15-28, but cross-region compliance might block some pilots.

Priya (Partnerships): Option A: Delay announcement by 1 week and keep APAC commitments. Option B: Proceed on-time but move SI pilots to EU (notify affected customers). Need decision by EOD to brief marketing.

Jorge (Logistics): Reached out to Orion for split manifest and earliest firmware rebuild. @OrionLogisticsBot manifest v2 uploaded: https://orion.example/manifest/rv2 :truck:

OrionLogisticsBot: manifest_v2.json uploaded by OrionCL - contains partial serial list and ETA per rack.

Marta (Sales): I'll ping top 5 affected customers and propose EU pilot fallback. Draft msg ready, can share.

Evelyn (Product): If we're leaning Option B, engineering needs the cross-region runbook. Sam can you confirm latency testing window this week?

Sam (Eng-Infra): Can do. I'll run a quick perf check tonight against eu-west and post results here. Will include expected token latency delta.

Priya (Partnerships): Thanks all — will compile options and send recommendation to leadership by 4pm. :thumbsup:
